_meta.note: Fontes sobre Nārada aprovadas em 2026-10-02: Bhāgavata Purāṇa (Dutt, scan DLI, livros I–VII), Nārada Bhakti Sūtra (Sturdy 1896), Harivaṃśa (Dutt 1897, Gutenberg) e Nārada Smṛti (Jolly, SBE 33, só a parte de Nārada, páginas do Sacred Texts via Wayback). O sânscrito do Bhāgavata no GRETIL fica catalogado (licença CC BY-NC-SA, fora do gate). Ingestão: etl=book (vedic_pipeline/etl/books.py), um registro por capítulo/grupo de sūtras/página.

sources.title: Nārada Bhakti Sūtra
sources.edition: Nārada Sūtra: An Inquiry into Love (Bhakti-jijñāsā), translated with an independent commentary by E. T. Sturdy, London: Longmans, Green, 1896. Google Books scan (Harvard) via archive.org, OCR text; the appendix (press notices on Vivekananda) is left out.
sources.license_note: Public domain in the US (published 1896; archive.org marks it NOT_IN_COPYRIGHT). Sturdy died in 1957, so in life+70 countries (Brazil, EU, UK) the translation and commentary only enter the public domain on 1 January 2028.
